name: Kimikage
source:
[url=/c91246]Alice[/url]'s second personality. Acting as a defensive mechanism, Kimikage would temporarily "replace" her in order to protect her mental state, on a trigger. In this story, the trigger is whenever Alice sees blood. To successfully do so, Kimikage is willing to take any measures, no matter the cost.

Not to be mistaken with Shirakawa Kimikage - Alice's biological father.
